cta-disabled.description: A disabled navigation button with an alert message when the feature is not yet implemented.
cta-disabled.code:
<Button asChild onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); alert('Not implemented yet'); }}>
  <Link href='/profile' className='w-full flex justify-center py-2' aria-disabled='true'>
    <Icon name='fa:FaUser' />
  </Link>
</Button>

cta-ready.description: An active navigation button that leads to /profile when the feature is ready.
cta-ready.code:
<Button asChild>
  <Link href='/profile' className='w-full flex justify-center py-2'>
    <Icon name='fa:FaUser' />
  </Link>
</Button>
